name: Quantong Holdings Limited
summary: Quantong Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a foundation subcontractor for private and public sectors in Hong Kong. It undertakes LS works; pipe piling and soldier piling for the construction of retaining walls; grouting and grout curtains construction that are used to form barriers to seal joints, reinforce steel and/or protect foundation works from water seepage; and groundwater control services. The company also provides pumping test administration for estimating the hydraulic properties of an aquifer system; pre-boring, a process of drilling a bore hole into the ground to prepare a site for foundation works; mini piling, which involves sinking a permanent casing into a pre-bored hole; bored piling construction; and H-piles for use in construction projects, including buildings, bridges, highways, and others. In addition, it is involved in the rental of machinery. It primarily serves main contractors and subcontractors. The company was formerly known as Pak Wing Group (Holdings) Limited and changed its name to Quantong Holdings Limited in February 2021. Quantong Holdings Limited was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
